principle: No single proxy validates broad human formation. Use convergent evidence from demanding external human judgment, professional standards, internalization, unseen transfer, adaptive-agency stress tests, real-world performance, expert/user judgment, and longitudinal observation.

proxies.name: All Souls College Examination Fellowship
proxies.strength: Expert human selection among exceptionally strong candidates using open-ended papers and viva; answers are generated rather than selected from a fixed key.
proxies.limitations: Humanities/social-sciences only; tests intellectual performance under examination conditions, not health, relationships, embodied skill, engineering execution, long-run life outcomes, or flourishing.

proxies.name: ABET engineering outcomes
proxies.strength: Mature external professional standard with explicit observable outcomes and continuous-improvement expectations.
proxies.limitations: Not a selective examination and does not validate the entire Obelisk.

proxies.name: National Academies learning/transfer evidence
proxies.strength: Research synthesis for what durable learning and transfer should mean.
proxies.limitations: A theory/evidence base, not a selection criterion or outcome test.

proxies.name: Obelisk General Examination
proxies.strength: Directly samples the intended graduate construct across intellectual and practical modes; can use independent external examiners and hidden task banks.
proxies.limitations: Cannot by itself validate its own curriculum; must be calibrated against external evidence and real-world consequences.

proxies.name: Adaptive Agency Stress Battery
proxies.strength: Useful stress-test of adaptive orientation and action when taught templates are unavailable.
proxies.limitations: A subordinate proxy only. Scenario performance cannot stand in for broad formation, relationships, meaning, taste, long-run character, actual grief/illness, or real institutional stakes.

proxies.name: Longitudinal completer cohort
constructs: life satisfaction/meaning by plural self-defined measures
proxies.strength: Only evidence class that observes whether the curriculum actually travels with people through real lives.
proxies.limitations: Slow, confounded by selection effects, ethically sensitive, impossible to reduce to one scalar life-success score; requires comparison groups or matched designs where feasible.
